summary: Every new hire fills in an employment eligibility form for the employer, who checks documents and keeps it on file.
realLife: Every U.S. employer must complete Form I-9 for each person it hires. The new employee fills in Section 1; the employer examines identity and work-authorization documents and keeps the form.
sources: USCIS, Employment Eligibility Verification (Form I-9): https://www.uscis.gov/i-9
inGame: the jobs module's hire row for the person (read by loadingTelling as first-job-year, citing the row). needs: an onboarding form on the hire record.
